subject: ইংরেজি লিখিত
question: Draft a formal Welcome and Technical Overview Speech (around 150-180 words) to be delivered by the Lead Maintenance Engineer at the inaugural ceremony of the newly installed 'e-Passport Rapid Self-Service Delivery Kiosks' at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.
answer:
Model Inaugural Speech:

"Honorable Chief Guest, Distinguished Officers, and Respected Guests,

A very warm welcome to this momentous inauguration ceremony celebrating the operational launch of our state-of-the-art e-Passport Rapid Self-Service Delivery Kiosks at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport.

Today marks a revolutionary leap forward in citizen service automation. These newly commissioned kiosks are equipped with high-speed optical barcode readers, multi-spectrum polycarbonate document verifiers, and sub-second dual-camera facial matching engines. When an applicant approaches the terminal, the machine verifies their digital token, cross-references biometric parameters against the central immigration database, and dispenses the physical smart e-passport in under forty-five seconds—without requiring human desk intervention.

Engineered with an impenetrable zero-trust architecture, automated audit logging, and dual uninterruptible power units, these kiosks guarantee 99.9% uptime and bulletproof data integrity. This achievement stands as a shining testament to our engineering dedication toward realizing the vision of 'Smart Bangladesh 2041'.

Thank you all for being part of this inspiring technological milestone!"
points_to_remember: A formal speech requires a dignified salutation, technical substance, and an uplifting conclusion.
